title: Active Brands Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC and Crown Darts UK Warn Consumers to Stop Using and Dispose of Banned Lawn Dart Sets; Recalling Firm is Unable to Conduct Recall
summary: Lawn darts are banned in the U.S. due to serious risks of skull punctures and other serious injuries, particularly to children. Units: About 19,400 darts (In addition, about 4,048 were sold in Canada).

title: Intertex Recalls Blowers Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The utility outlets on the side of the blowers are not protected by a circuit breaker. If the outlet becomes overloaded or short-circuited, it could overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 189,000 (In addition, about 8,153 were sold in Canada).

title: Thule Recalls Strollers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The stroller's handlebar can detach, posing an injury hazard to children. Units: About 4,000 (In addition, about 880 were sold in Canada).

title: Transform Recalls Four-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Kmart
summary: The recalled chests are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 19,900.

title: REVIVE Essential Oil Recalls Wintergreen and Birch Essential Oils and Sore No More, Ache Away and Breeze Essential Oil Blends Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 26

title: Hercules Recalls Moravian Star Lights Due to Fire and Electrical Shock Hazards
summary: The lights lack adequate minimum wire size and overcurrent protection, posing fire and electrical shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 50,000.

title: WD-40 Company Recalls X-14 Mildew Stain Remover Due to Risk of Skin Irritation
summary: Pressure can build up inside the bottle and cause it to fall over and leak, posing a risk of skin irritation. Units: About 130,000.

title: Amazon Recalls Calmer Solutions Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 6.

title: Amazon Recalls Mystic Moments Birch Sweet Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 54.

title: CPSC and Morpher Warn Consumers to Stop Using and Dispose of Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Recalling Firm is Unable to Conduct Recall (Recall Alert)
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 8,500.

title: CMP Group Recalls Dock Ladders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The edges on the side of the steps are sharp and can cut consumers, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 750.

title: Communicorp Recalls Plush Aflac Doctor Duck Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The buttons on the lab coat worn by the Doctor Duck contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content standard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 635,500.

title: woom bikes USA Recalls Children's Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not meet the federal safety standard, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 1,900.

title: Hasbro Recalls Super Soaker XP 20 and XP 30 Water Blasters Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The decorative sticker on the water tank of the water blaster toys contain levels of lead in the ink that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 52,900.

title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls to Repair CFMK Surface Mount Brackets Used with CPANL LEDs Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The brackets can fail to securely surface mount the CPANL LED and fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury from impact. Units: About 318,500 (in addition, about 11,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Pier 1 Recalls Three-Wick Halloween Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle's high flames can ignite the surface of the wax, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 30,810.

title: Signature Hardware Recalls Medicine Cabinets Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The mirror can detach and fall from the medicine cabinet door, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,300.
